# Interacting with data in the Map Canvas - Statistics Canada QGIS Demo 4

> **Provenance note:** This file comes from the publisher's web page, not from Brightspace. Verbatim retrieval was not possible through the available fetch tool (it returned a detailed paraphrase only), so the text below is a faithful point-by-point **paraphrase of the published transcript**, with UI names quoted as they appear in the transcript. It is not an auto-caption and not verbatim.

1. Focus: the **Map Canvas** with tools on the **Map Navigation** and **Attribute** toolbars.
2. **Pan Map** is active by default: click and drag to move.
3. **Zoom** tools: drag a box (small box = big zoom change); the mouse wheel also zooms.
4. **Zoom to Full**: extent of all active layers (useful when a layer cannot be found).
5. **Zoom to Layer**: extent of the layer selected in the Layers panel (road segments zoom to Manitoba).
6. **Zoom Last** / **Zoom Next**: undo/redo zoom changes.
7. **Spatial Bookmark**: save a named extent and return to it from the bookmark panel.
8. Grouping: select layers with Shift/Ctrl, right-click > **Group Selected**; toggle groups or individual layers; right-click > Move out or drag.
9. Attribute toolbar tools used: **Interactive Selection** and **Identify** (act on the selected layer).
10. Interactive Selection on Census Division: click or drag to select; Ctrl adds/removes single features, Shift adds many; **Deselect** icon clears.
11. Selection drop-down: **Select by Polygon** (click vertices, right-click to close); **Select by Radius** (click centre then radius, or type the radius at top right).
12. Identify: click a feature to open the **Identify** panel (geometry and attributes); drag to identify many; **Collapse All** / **Expand All**.
13. Right-click > **Identify All** returned 2 division and 6 subdivision features.
14. Identify **Mode**: switch from **Current** to **Top-Down** to query all active layers (example in Northern Ontario returned features from three layers incl. hydrology).
15. **Clear Results** clears identified features.
16. Next demo: the **Attribute table** and **Layer Properties** box.
